panels.title: Fleet verdict
panels.description: egress_fleet_verdict_state, published by @egress/aggregator from every replica's circuit.control events, computed off the hot path. Never read back into any replica's own decision — notification only.

panels.title: Breaker state per replica
panels.description: egress_consumer_breaker_state, one line per instance. Each replica's breaker is independent — watch them open and close at different moments, not together.

panels.title: Work queue depth — payments-provider.work
panels.description: Messages ready plus in flight. Climbs for as long as breakers stay open: a message turned away by an open breaker is released uncounted, so it waits here rather than dead-lettering.

panels.title: Dead-letter queue depth — payments-provider.work.dead
panels.description: Messages that exhausted the broker's delivery limit (x-delivery-limit, 3 attempts). The SAC-elected redriver moves these back onto the work queue once its own breaker closes, on every reset and a 30s sweep — see Redrives and Redrive.ts.

panels.title: Calls to the third party, by outcome
panels.description: egress_consumer_calls_total. "open": rejected by this replica's own breaker, or a half-open probe that lost the permit race — never reached the third party. "client_error": a 4xx other than 408/429, the third party's own refusal — dead-lettered at once, not counted by the breaker.

panels.title: Breaker trips
panels.description: sum(rate(egress_consumer_breaker_trips_total)) across all replicas — each trip is one breaker opening. Counts events, not disagreement; see the state-timeline panel for that.

panels.title: Active consumers on the work queue
panels.description: The broker's own count — should track --scale rmq-consumer=N. A gap from the replica count means a daemon stopped consuming.

panels.title: Parked queue depth — payments-provider.work.parked
panels.description: Messages redriven MAX_REDRIVES (5) times without succeeding — true poison, not just an outage. Should stay 0 for any incident this series injects; nonzero means something the third party will never accept.

panels.title: Redrives
panels.description: sum(rate(egress_consumer_redrives_total)) by outcome. Nonzero only on the SAC-elected redriver — one replica, not the whole fleet.

panels.title: Failed and refused calls, by HTTP status
panels.description: egress_consumer_calls_total for outcome failed or client_error, by status — the HTTP status answered, or timeout/network when none came. See "Calls to the third party, by outcome" for what counts as client_error.
